# Sloboda — Батальйон безпілотних систем

> Official site of the "Sloboda" UAV battalion, part of the 11th Brigade of the National Guard of Ukraine. Recruiting, support fund, news.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the unit, mission, and key directions.
- [Vacancies](/vacancies): Open positions for UAV operators, technicians, analysts, and support roles.
- [About](/about): History and structure of the Sloboda airspace cover detachment.
- [Fund](/fund): How to support the unit financially.
- [News](/news): Operational and unit news updates.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles and longer-form posts from the unit.
